steps.title: Heat the garlic
steps.instruction: Heat two garlic cloves in olive oil until they start to simmer.

steps.title: Add the tomatoes
steps.instruction: Add one can of diced tomatoes to the pan.

steps.title: Season the sauce
steps.instruction: Add basil, oregano, parsley, pepper, and optional red pepper flakes.

steps.title: Thicken the sauce
steps.instruction: Mix in tomato paste and a small amount of water.

steps.title: Make the sauce creamy
steps.instruction: Mix in cream cheese when you want a creamy sauce.
